subject.title: [P0] Feishu connector: sequential queue deadlock + self-talk feedback loop under slow LLM

question: Which remaining Feishu slow-run repair boundary should be canonical: Feishu queue admission/bypass, abort/backpressure semantics for timed-out work, session-lock handling, or a coordinated fix that spans those surfaces?
rationale: Current main only fixes self-open-id echoes; the remaining behavior crosses channel ordering, active-run queue policy, cancellation/backpressure, and session-lock recovery, so automation cannot safely choose the permanent product boundary.

options.title: Keep Broad Incident Open
options.body: Use this issue as the canonical tracker while maintainers choose and land a coordinated repair across the remaining queue, abort/backpressure, and session-lock slices.

options.title: Split By Remaining Slice
options.body: Move the active-followup, timeout-abort, and session-lock pieces to narrower canonical issues only if each has a clear owner and this broad issue is closed after linking them.

options.title: Close After Self-Echo Fix Only
options.body: Close based on the merged self-open-id filter and accept that the live-reproduced queue/session-lock symptoms remain tracked elsewhere or untracked.

recommendation.title: Keep Broad Incident Open
recommendation.body: Use this issue as the canonical tracker while maintainers choose and land a coordinated repair across the remaining queue, abort/backpressure, and session-lock slices.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the current timeout-eviction behavior and have direct history on the Feishu queue boundary that still needs a maintainer-level fix shape.
